reference: Polymetallic massive sulfide, Potter Mine (Commons title)

description.lithology: Fine-grained altered mafic volcanic rock, mottled green-grey to brassy-yellow with dark blue-grey bands, massive in the green portion to streaky-banded to foliated in the sulfide-rich portion.
description.alteration: Moderate to strong chloritic alteration in the green-grey host, overprinted by strong sulfide replacement in the right half.
description.mineralization: Chalcopyrite (brassy-yellow) with dark blue-grey bornite-chalcocite, semi-massive to massive streaky-banded with disseminated blebs, ~35-45 vol% overall and ~80-90 vol% in the right half.

anomalies.explanation: Brassy-yellow chalcopyrite with dark blue-grey sulfides forms a semi-massive to massive streaky-banded zone over the right half of the piece with disseminated blebs in the green host on the left.
A central gradational contact-mineralization front between green altered host on the left and sulfide-dominated rock on the right should be checked for control and assay boundaries.
